sources.title: Problems with communication, staffing, equipment in wildfire that killed 4 firefighters
Deaths of 4 firefighters in Colorado wildfire caused by extreme fire behavior, human error, report finds

en.title: Four firefighters died in Colorado wildfire on 12 November 2026
en.dek: Reports detail causes of the deaths, citing extreme fire behavior and operational issues
facts: Four firefighters died in a Colorado wildfire
Colorado Public Radio reported problems with communication, staffing, and equipment
The Denver Post reported the deaths were caused by extreme fire behavior and human error
body: Colorado Public Radio reported problems with communication, staffing, and equipment during the wildfire on 12 November 2026.
The Denver Post reported that a finding stated the deaths resulted from extreme fire behavior and human error.
The reporting from both outlets occurred on 12 November 2026.
en.context: The sources report on the aftermath of the wildfire and the findings regarding the fatalities.

zh.title: 科罗拉多州野火中四名消防员遇难 12 月 2 日
zh.dek: 报道详述了死亡原因，引用极端火势行为和作业问题
facts: 四名消防员在科罗拉多州野火中遇难
科罗拉多公共广播电台报告称存在通讯、人员编制和装备问题
《丹佛邮报》报道称死亡原因是极端火势行为和人为错误
body: 科罗拉多公共广播电台报道，2026年11月12日野火期间存在通讯、人员配备和设备问题。
《丹佛邮报》报道称，调查结果指出，死亡是极端火灾行为和人为失误造成的。
两家媒体的报道均于2026年11月12日发布。

problemsFixed: The headline is not a purely factual statement of what happened; it attributes causation without clear consensus in the sources.
The draft contains unsupported claims, such as the incident occurring in 2026 (the sources provide dates of reporting, not the event date, though the reporting dates are 2026-11-12).
The draft uses evaluative framing (e.g., 'contributed to the incident', 'primary factors').
The draft contains repetitive phrasing and lacks structural rhythm as required by the style guide.
The context section introduces speculation about 'recent years' and 'prompting reviews' which is not supported by the provided sources.
